Boxes G–L (digital assets reported on Form 1099-DA; f8949 p. 1: "(G) Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS") are refused at the transaction: `sales.one` refuses when `sales.digital` is true, the refusal propagates through `sd.count` to `sd.screen`, and every Schedule D total refuses on `sd.screen` before any box filter runs. No change to the data.
